title: 信息日报 2026-08-19

headline.title: Mojo🔥 现已开源
headline.summary: Mojo编程语言正式开源，采用Apache 2.0许可证发布编译器与工具链。Mojo旨在结合Python的易用性与C的性能，适用于AI开发。自2023年承诺开源以来，历经多次延期，如今在1.0版本后兑现诺言。
headline.summary_en: The Mojo programming language has been open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license, releasing its compiler and toolchain. Designed to combine Python's usability with C-like performance for AI development, Mojo has delivered on its long-promised open-source release following its 1.0 launch.
headline.reason: 这是当天对开发者社区影响最大的事件，标志着新型AI编程语言的里程碑式开源。
headline.reason_en: This is the most impactful event for the developer community today, marking the milestone open-sourcing of a new AI-focused programming language.
